description.value:
Needs a CrystalDome. Windows intact and still for 1 minute, the driver cloaks the vehicle and everyone in it from all sight, cyberoptics included (DV17 Perception to spot). Moving over 10m in a Round or firing a mount drops it; an open door only reveals that door. Second install: 10 Rounds still; third: 3 Rounds.

Cost / Moto: Moto 5
Fits: All Vehicles with an enclosed interior except Gyrocopters, Helicopters, and Aerozeps
